title: AI-Upscaled Monitors & Sauron's Sonic Security Vision
description:
Welcome to the latest episode of AI Edge, where hosts Alex and Jamie dive into a whirlwind of tech innovation and leadership buzz in the AI realm. 

Kicking off with a jaw-dropping announcement, Jamie reveals how LG is stepping up the gaming world with their UltraGear evo monitors, now enhanced with AI technology for superior upscaling - a move that's set to redefine visual quality expectations. 

Shifting gears, Alex and Jamie break down the strategic CEO appointment at Sauron, the upscale home security start-up. By bringing onboard an industry veteran from Sonos, Sauron hints at a bold new direction, possibly integrating top-notch audio technology into its already premium security systems. It’s a game-changer, drawing parallels to the transformation seen in the luxury car market. 

Today’s big ticket discussion also touches on the ethics and implications of AI advancements in both visual and auditory domains, positioning Sauron on the cutting edge of technology. Join us as we delve deep into how these advancements are not just about technology updates, but are redefining user experiences in everyday security and entertainment. 

Special mention: This episode is powered by ElevenLabs, the frontier in AI audio technology, making advanced sound capabilities a reality. If your interest is piqued, hop over to ElevenLabs.io and explore how AI can revolutionize audio in your projects. 

Tune in for insights, expert commentary, and the excitement of tech evolution that's aiming at reshaping the realms of gaming and security.
